title: 2013 AMC 12A Problem 6
statement: In a recent basketball game, Shenille attempted only three-point shots and two-point shots. She was successful on \(20\%\) of her three-point shots and \(30\%\) of her two-point shots. Shenille attempted \(30\) shots. How many points did she score?

solutions.text:
If Shenille attempted \(x\) three-point shots and \(30 - x\) two-point shots, she scored \[ \begin{gathered} 0.2\cdot 3\cdot x + 0.3\cdot 2\cdot(30 - x) \\ = 0.6x + 0.6(30 - x) \\ = 0.6\cdot 30 = 18 \end{gathered} \] points.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let \(x\) be the number of three-point attempts, so \(30 - x\) are two-point attempts
Her score is \(0.2\cdot 3\cdot x + 0.3\cdot 2\cdot(30 - x);\) the \(x\) terms cancel
